attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the authoritative/forwarding DNS resolver for the shared 10.100.246.0/24 network via an Ansible playbook run from control node node4. node1 answers inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.246.11) via a VyOS authoritative-domain record and forwards everything else to upstream public resolvers (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9). node2 and node3 (CentOS Stream 10) were pointed at node1 for resolution via NetworkManager (nmcli). Verified functional resolution end-to-end, then performed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all four managed nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery.
